descriptionByLocale.it:
• Business Management support for the COO
• Managing the governance of outsourcing, and 3rd party services in general, for UBP Asia, to ensure that the outsourced services are managed in accordance with local regulations
• Coordinator and Secretary of UBP Asia Support and Control Management Committee
• Coordinator and Secretary of UBP HK Outsourcing Committee and UBP SG Third Party Service Provider Management Committee
• Develop and/or administer other governance programme for UBP Asia
• Secretary of UBP HK Branch ExCo
• Business Contingency Management (BCM) coordinator for HK
• Manage Business Contingency Plans for HK
• Develop and administer the Operational Resiliency framework
• Event management and escalation (e.g. Typhoon, business critical incident)
• BCP reporting
• BCP and DR test management, coordination and reporting
• Project Management support for COO
• Asia PM resource to manage or co-ordinate Asia projects as required
• Support internal and external assessments on matters pertaining the support and control functions as required
• Comply with external and internal compliance and regulatory requirements, including the Bank’s policies, operating procedures and controls to meet the Bank’s and regulatory requirements and protect the business from financial and reputational risk
• Supports the strategy and delivery of all General Services activities for the branch including, but not limited to: facilities management; office space planning; procurement; landlord-tenant relations; client reception operations.
• Support the CE and COO on real-estate planning, and negotiation and entering into rental or other real estate related arrangements with landlord and third parties.
• Manage procurement process and be responsible for suppliers management, ensuring suppliers are on-boarded in a manner which conforms to the global procurement policy.
• Pursue CSR standards pertaining facilities, e.g. energy efficient lighting etc, and support the bank’s CSR process including annual carbon footprint calculation.
• Manage secure documents archival and destruction service for UBP HK by engaging and managing specialized third party service provider.
• Support Crisis Management and Security as needed from a Facilities perspective.
• Supervise the General Services Manager of UBP HK and other staff of the department.
• Engage in budget planning and human resources planning for the General Services department.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission We are seeking an experienced Fixed Income Execution Trader to join our team in Geneva. For this full-time position, a solid background in bond markets, advanced execution skills and the ability to perform in a fast-paced environment is requested. Individual’s role will focus on day-to-day execution of fixed income orders in primary and secondary markets, optimizing execution strategies, and contributing to the automation of order workflows. The candidate is expected to be learning and supporting execution in other asset classes and take part to late shift coverage for US markets (up to 22:00).
• Main responsibilities
• Efficient and accurate trade execution (voice and electronic) in secondary markets (Credit IG and HY, Rates, Emerging Markets, Money Markets).
• Oversee full bookbuilding processes in primary markets (publish new issues, collect subscriptions, distribute allocations)
• Play an integral part of a ‘value added’ basis to investment process by leveraging market knowledge and counterparty contacts to improve performance and influence outcomes
• Monitor and share market news and liquidity conditions with Wealth Management teams and build trust-based internal relationships
• Develop and maintain strong, transparent and constructive relationships with brokers and counterparties to obtain the best service for the bank’s clients
• Run and optimize electronic execution and RFQs via Bloomberg (e.g., IB/TSOX), MarketAxess, and Tradeweb
• Develop and implement Fixed Income execution strategies to optimize trading performance and client outcomes
• Contribute to the automation of bond order workflows and the integration of trading technologies
• Late-shift coverage (up to 22:00): mandatory multi-asset execution across Fixed Income, Equities, and ETDs
• Ensure strict compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements (e.g., best execution, record-keeping)
• Your Profile
• Experience : Minimum of 5 years trading experience in Fixed Income primary and secondary markets with a proven track record
• Product Knowledge : Deep understanding of Fixed Income products and market structure, liquidity dynamics, RFQ protocols, and new issue processes
• Trading Venues and Platforms : Hands-on experience executing via Bloomberg (IB/TSOX), MarketAxess, and Tradeweb; extensive use of InvestorAccess and DirectBooks for new issues
• Execution Skills: Strong voice trading and e-trading capabilities; familiarity with auto-routing, dealer selection, and best-ex filters.
• Languages: Fluency in English and French is a prerequisite.
• Technology: Advanced Excel; VBA and/or Python are a strong advantage, particularly for automating bond workflows and reporting.
• Versatility: Willingness to learn and execute another asset class as needed; ability to switch between tools and processes.
• Stress Management: Ability to perform under pressure in a high-stakes, fast-paced environment.
• Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy in execution, allocations, and post-trade reporting.
• Passion for Markets: Genuine enthusiasm for Fixed Income and trading innovation.
• Core Competencies
• Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility.
• Strong commitment to compliance with regulations and internal directives.
• Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and team collaboration.
• Others
• Swiss Residence is required

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission As part of the Tax Services team, the Tax Specialist is a key element to ensure the quality and accuracy of the reporting done by the Bank, as a regulatory obligation, in an environment which is subject to constant changes and evolutions. Within the Daily Regulatory Reporting team, the employee’s mission also includes constant monitoring and reconciliation of the data to be reported. The tax and regulatory topics include MIFID II/ EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG / Duty to disclose.
• Main responsibilities
• Daily monitoring and control of regulatory reporting (MIFID II / EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG) sent to the reporting platform(s) (i.e. locals regulators)
• Monthly reconciliations, quality control and statistics of the data reported
• Manage inquiries and investigate questions and issues about the taxes or regulatory reporting from other departments of the Bank or from external counterparties
• Understand regulatory risk sensitivity and has an end-to-end view of the Bank’s flow/process
• Correction of consistency issues, update reporting tool’s database
• Liaising and coordinating with the department responsible for the underlying data for the necessary corrections, explanations, data input and resubmission of the corrected report(s)
• Communication with the reporting engine providers (ARM, APA, TR)
• Performing regular and ad-hoc reporting related to statistics for internal and external parties
• Contribute to all testing linked to regulatory and reporting updates
• Active participation in EMIR/MIFID/DTD projects (Audit inquiries, Provider specifications changes & Regulator inquiries) including data mining and in-depth investigation
• Open mind and team orientation: Be open to other’s ideas. Express and accept constructive criticism.
• Innovation and development: Propose and seek improvement of the current tools and processes. Be positive towards change and seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment. Conitunuously work on knowledge improvement.
• Corporate culture: Be ‘solution oriented’ and have a strong sense of customer services. Be proactive and driven. Developp and maintain a relationship network within the various Bank departments. Comply consistently with internal and external regulations.
• Your Profile
• Good knowledge of the financial products and associated transactions
• 3-5 years of experience in banking or financial services
• Project management experience
• Strong Excel, Access skills
• Strong analytical skills, able to make complex data reconciliation
• Ability to efficiently manage priorities
• Be able to work independently but also as a team
• Seek opportunities to improve the existing set-up
• Go beyond specific assignments, walk the extra mile
• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations
• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures
• Fluent in French and English
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

titleByLocale.it: Help Desk Officer - 1° livello di supporto

titleByLocale.de: Help Desk Officer - 1st level of support
titleByLocale.fr: Help Desk Officer - 1st level of support

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Based in our main office in Geneva, you will join the Global Service Desk team, providing first-line support to approximately 3,000 Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) colleagues worldwide. Main responsibilities
• Answer to the Global Service Desk phone line for all UBP users worldwide.
• Manage emails sent to Global Service Desk.
• Manage workload from our self-ticketing tool.
• Provide remote assistance to users and try to resolve the problem on first call.
• Create incidents with clear and explicit information and assign to level 2 teams if necessary.
• Knowledge documentation and procedures updates.
• Working hours: Weekdays, shift coverage from 07:30 to 19:00. Your Profile
• Help Desk Institute Certification (CFC) or equivalent.
• A first successful experience in a Help Desk service is mandatory.
• Microsoft Operating System Certification(s) will be an asset.
• ITIL Foundation Certification will be an asset.
• Expertise in Microsoft Windows 11 and Microsoft 365 (Office 365)
• Experience with Citrix and VDI environments and with Remote Access connection (RSA Secure ID, Citrix Workspace).
• Knowledge of, Active Directory, GPO, SCCM, Networking.
• Knowledge on Mobility: iOS and iPhone, iPad.
• JIRA service management tool knowledge.
• Fluent in French and English; additional languages considered an asset. Competencies
• Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Highly customer service oriented.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Assist the relationship manager(s) in opening new relationships and serving clients, in compliance with the Bank’s internal regulations and guidelines within the Eastern Europe region. Main responsibilities
• Prepare the necessary documentation for client meetings and business trips for relationship managers
• Execute and monitor stock exchange orders, forex transactions, fiduciary relationships, loans, payment orders and credit card applications
• Provide administrative support to the Team Head
• Cash Management
• Assist in AML clarifications and prepare clients KYC and related updates with direct line contact
• Direct interaction with clients by phone, e-mail and, occasionally in meetings
• Prepare and monitor account openings, closings and mutations
• Maintain records in compliance with internal and external regulation (for example: portfolio reviews, AML, KYC, etc.)
• Perform other administrative tasks as needed (for example: preparing presentations, travel arrangements, helping clients with any requests, banking and non-banking, etc.)
• Deputy of other assistants if needed Your Profile
• Degree in a related field (banking apprenticeship, CYP, banking internship or similar)
• Private Banking certificate, CWMA or other equivalent certification a plus
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role in a Private Bank
• Strong banking and KYC knowledge
• Strong team spirit, inter-personal skills, open-minded, highly service and client oriented as well as excellent communication skills
• Fluent in French and English. Russian would be a strong added value Others
• Swiss Residence mandatory Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Through the Asset Management division, we offer to institutional clients’ investment management capabilities organised across the business lines Long-Only Platform, Alternative Investment Solutions, Private Markets Group, Partnerships, Asset Allocation & DPM. The Institutional Client Service Team serves as the primary contact for large and complex institutional clients globally, supporting sales teams in engaging institutional and wholesale clients. The team plays a vital role in enhancing profitability and driving growth within the Asset Management business. We are seeking a dynamic candidate with a strong interest in Asset Management to join the Institutional Client Service team in Frankfurt . This role involves close collaboration with the German sales team, reporting locally to the Head of Wholesale EMEA and centrally to the COO - Institutional Clients & Head of the Client Service Team. The position covers activities with both institutional and wholesale clients in the DACH region (Germany, German-speaking Switzerland, and Austria) This position is for 12 months, but it may be renewed or offer other opportunities. Main responsibilities
• Assist Asset Management Sales teams in supporting German-speaking client-base.
• Manage, execute, and follow up on client requests and inquiries.
• Collaborate with internal teams throughout the client lifecycle to ensure client satisfaction and retention.
• Coordinate the onboarding process and oversee the end-to-end transition.
• Involve in the implementation and monitoring of the local sales strategy.
• Support the team in their prospecting initiatives, including the preparation of marketing materials and conducting market research.
• Contribute to the optimization of processes through the application of AI technologies.
• Act as the local CRM champion, supporting and training the sales team to meet Salesforce requirements and ensure data accuracy.
• Organise local events and roadshows.
• Perform office management tasks. Your Profile
• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, or a related field is beneficial.
• Excellent organizational skills and capability to work independently.
• Accuracy and attention to detail.
• Advanced skills in standard IT applications (MS Office).
• Mother tongue German and fluency in English is a “MUST”; French is a “nice to have”. Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks. By joining UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility. UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission As a Senior Legal Advisor specialized in investment funds, you will play a central role within UBP Management Company, UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. You will be involved in a broad range of fund related legal and regulatory matters, including regulatory compliance, fund governance, and structuring of new products. You will work closely with all stakeholders of the Management Company, providing legal expertise to support the company’s strategic and operational activities. You will also collaborate daily with our Product Management team and actively contributing to the structuring, management, and evolution of investment products. This key role will allow you to work on diverse projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a dynamic and international environment. You will also be in charged of the corporate governance of the _Management Company and its branches.
• Your main responsibilities will be:
• Legal Advice :
• Provide legal advice on the company’s activities, particularly in corporate law, investment fund law, and financial law.
• Ensure the company’s activities comply with local and European regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).
• Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, partnership agreements, management mandates, and other legal documents.
• Collaboration with the Product Management Team:
• Work closely with the Product Management team on the structuring, implementation, and management of investment products.
• Provide legal support for the development of new products and the update of existing ones.
• Fund Management:
• Oversee the creation, structuring, and legal management of investment funds (UCITS, AIF, SICAV, FIS, RAIF, etc.).
• Prepare and update legal documentation for funds (prospectus, articles of association, management regulations, etc.).
• Manage relationships with regulatory authorities (CSSF) and follow up on regulatory requests.
• Compliance and Regulatory Monitoring :
• Conduct legal and regulatory monitoring to anticipate legislative changes and their impact on the company’s activities.
• Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure adherence to legal and regulatory obligations.
• Litigation Management :
• Handle potential disputes in collaboration with external law firms.
• Defend the company’s interests in litigation or judicial proceedings.
• Training and Support:
• Train and raise awareness among internal teams about regulatory developments and best legal practices.
• Provide legal support to various departments within the company.
• Your Profile:
• Master’s degree in Business Law, Corporate Law, or Financial Law.
• Specialization in investment fund law or financial law is an asset.
• 5 to 10 years of experience as a legal counsel in a Management Company, law firm, or financial institution in Luxembourg.
• Proved experience in managing investment funds (UCITS, AIF, etc.).
• Excellent knowledge of corporate law, investment fund law, and Luxembourg and European financial regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).
• Proficiency in the processes of structuring and managing investment funds.
• Ability to draft and negotiate complex contracts in both French and English.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent analytical and synthesis skills.
• Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Discretion and respect for confidentiality (knowledge of German or Luxembourgish is an asset). descriptionByLocale.it:
Job Description - Please note we do not offer sponsorship This is a unique 12-month programme based on a permanent contract within our Wealth Management Team in Jersey. We are offering an exceptional opportunity for a recent master’s graduate to join our exclusive programme, designed to provide in-depth exposure to Wealth Management at a renowned Private Bank. The programme offers a comprehensive learning experience, enabling you to gain valuable insights into the finance industry and develop essential skills for a successful career in private banking. The graduate programme consists of 3 rotations each lasting 4 months. These rotations take place in different teams, all closely connected to Wealth Management and Treasury and Trading, providing an excellent opportunity to build a broad internal network of colleagues and experts. Furthermore, you will benefit from shadowing experiences, gaining valuable exposure to various aspects of the bank’s operation. This programme is specifically designed for young graduates holding a master’s degree, with a maximum of 12 months of professional experience since graduation. You will have the opportunity to transition into a permanent role within the team after completing the programme. Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) – Wealth Management: Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is one of the largest family-owned private banks in the world. But what makes UBP unique is its corporate culture, which combines modernity and tradition. Although UBP was founded in 1969, its origins can be traced back to the 17th century and the start of a long line of financiers and diplomats of whom Edgar de Picciotto and his descendants are the successors. Today, the Bank's staff draw their inspiration and drive from the founding family's subtle blend of strong moral values and pragmatism, which to this day remain the key to UBP’s success. As it plays such a major part in our strategy, we are investing significantly in Wealth Management to fuel our growth, particularly in Europe, the Middle East, Eastern Europe, Latin America, and Asia. We provide a complete range of private banking products and services, including a variety of investment management and advisory mandates, tailored to our clients’ specific requirements, objectives, and risk profiles. Among UBP professional partners, over 300 independent asset managers have chosen us as their custodian bank, valuing our personalised, flexible services and our transparent fee structure. Role Description:
• You will be part of the Wealth Management Team in Jersey:
• Relationship with private clients and marketing
• With the guidance of relationship managers and experts: Cultivate relationships with clients Respond to clients’/prospects’ needs with investments proposals Ensure that contractual documents and supporting paperwork are signed and up to date Comply with the Bank’s internal directives, considering the client’s profile and types of transactions Assisting relationship managers With the guidance of relationship managers and experts: Follow up on and execute administrative tasks: account paperwork filing, transaction executions, trade executions, transfers, discretionary management and advisory mandate processing, client query responses Ensure clients’ transactions/instructions/requests (stock market orders, transfers, tax report requests, product information, etc.) are executed and addressed correctly and swiftly Provide administrative support to the relationship managers by preparing visits and trips, filing client data and documents, and checking that clients’ investments are consistent with their risk profiles UNION BANCAIRE PRIVÉE, UBP SA | WM GRADUATE PROGRAMME | MARCH26 2 | 3
• Carry out first-level checks as per internal directives, where applicable, and escalate transactions or situations putting the Bank at risk, to the line manager
• Treasury and Trading
• With the guidance of the Treasury and Trading Manager Forecast near and long-term cash follows across the entity Maintain buffers and contingency liquidity
• Coordinate intercompany funding and optimise notional/physical pooling
• Funding and Capital Markets
• With the guidance of the Treasury and Trading Manager Plan and execute short- and long-term funding, i.e. bonds and loans Maintain bank and investor relationships
• Monitor costs of funds and refinance risk, manage maturities
• Risk Management
• With the guidance of the Treasury and Trading Manager Identify exposures Set and enforce risk limits, hedging and effective metrics Execute hedges via forward, swaps and options Stress testing, sensitivity analysis and scenario planning Compliance with regulations and internal directives Learn to know and strictly apply all internal directives and rules, baking laws and regulations, such as those regarding entering business relations with clients, contacts/relations with clients (existing or prospective), anti-money-laundering, cross-border business, investment policies, investor protection, business travel Attend the Bank's compulsory training session Requirements: Educational Background: Master’s degree in financial economics recently obtained from a highly recognised university Work Experience: Relevant initial work experience in the finance industry (internships), preferably within Private Banking or Wealth Management Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of Excel Language Proficiency: Fluency in English is required Key Skills: Strong analytical skills, structured approach, excellent communication, and a proactive, adaptable mindset. Ability to collaborate across business and technical teams, with a self-motivated, results-driven attitude Work Authorisation: Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK and Jersey at the time of application. We do not offer sponsorship Jersey residential and employment status Applications Process: We only accept online applications submitted through our official website, ensure that your application includes the following documents: CV Motivation Letter Grade Transcript & Diplomas Reference Letters
• UNION BANCAIRE PRIVÉE, UBP SA | WM GRADUATE PROGRAMME | MARCH26 3 | 3
• Key Dates: ¦ Programme start date: 1st September 2026 ¦ Duration of programme: 12 months (permanent contract) ¦ Interviews Period: March to June 2026

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission The Invoice Officer in Accounts Payable is responsible for the accurate processing of invoices and ensuring timely payments to vendors (approximately 350 invoices per month). This role involves maintaining financial records, resolving discrepancies, and supporting the overall account payable function. The Invoice Officer will also collaborate closely with IT procurement and business IT partners to enhance operational efficiency and ensure alignment with financial practices.
• Main responsibilities include but not limited to : 1. Invoice Processing: - Review and verify invoices for accuracy and completeness. - Enter invoices into the information system (Coupa/Dynamics Navision) and ensure proper coding. - Participate in projects focused on processes transformation 2. Payment Processing: - Prepare and process payment runs. - Monitor payment schedules and ensure timely payments to vendors. 3. Vendor Management: - Communicate with vendors regarding invoice status and payment inquiries. - Assist in resolving any disputes or discrepancies. 4. Record Keeping: - Maintain accurate and organized accounts payable records. - Prepare and manage monthly accruals to ensure accurate financial reporting and compliance with accounting standards. - Provide detailed business allocation of depreciation for projects - Ensure all invoices are filed according to company policy. 5. Reporting: - Assist in generating accounts payable reports for management review. - Support month-end closing activities related to accounts payable. - Provide detailed report related to mobile communication costs on a quarterly basis. 6. Compliance: - Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards. - Assist in audits by providing necessary documentation and information.
• Qualifications:
• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.
• Previous experience in accounts payable or a similar role is mandatory.
• Previous experience with Coupa and MS Dynamics is preferable
• Proficient in accounting software and Microsoft Office Suite.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and financial reporting.
• Proficient verbal and written communication skills in both French and English for effective collaboration with vendors and internal teams.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission: Support the continuous improvement of Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) processes (AML, KYC, Sanctions) by working closely with Compliance, Business, and IT teams. Contribute to aligning Compliance requirements with operational processes and IT tools while enhancing process efficiency and establishing a robust control framework. Responsibilities
• Support the analysis of business needs and contribute to integrating compliance requirements into financial crime prevention processes (AML, KYC, Sanctions). Assist in identifying process improvement opportunities and implementing solutions validated by stakeholders (Compliance, Front Office, IT, etc.).
• Design and implement streamlined, scalable, and effective processes to enhance operational performance and compliance with regulatory requirements.
• Participate in the documentation and updating of processes related to compliance, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring alignment with current practices and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. Tools & Projects teams, etc.) for the development, maintenance, and testing of compliance applications (IMTF, smartKYC, Pythagoras, etc.).
• Contribute to change management , particularly by supporting training and communication initiatives for users.
• Participate in functional testing of implemented solutions, using provided methodologies and tools, and ensuring rigorous follow-up of results.
• Support the improvement of control frameworks related to compliance tools, including monitoring incidents, analyzing data quality, and collecting user feedback.
• Assist in monitoring compliance tools , ensuring the proper functioning of data flows, updating parameters, and conducting regular review exercises in collaboration with IT and Tools & Projects teams.
• Contribute to project management related to AML, KYC, and sanctions by participating in local or group initiatives and engaging in project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall).
• Participate in technological watch and identify opportunities to improve compliance tools and processes.
• Support the follow-up of audit recommendations related to operational compliance processes, ensuring their implementation within the required deadlines. Your Profil
• Education and experience: experience in compliance financial crime, risk management, or operational processes is preferred. At least 5 years of experience and experience in a consulting firm (Big 4 ou equivalent) is an asset
• Analytical skills: Ability to analyze processes, identify ineficciencies, gaps and areas for improvement, and propose appropriate solutions.
• Communication skills: Proficiency in drafting clear and structured documents, as well as communicating effectively with various stakeholders.
• Team spirit: Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams (Compliance, Business, IT) and adapt to different interlocutors.
• Organization and rigor: Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously while respecting deadlines and priorities.
• Technical knowledge: familiarity with compliance technology solutions, data analytics tools, and automation platforms. Experience or interest in data management, reporting, or process modeling tools is a plus.
• Languages: Proficiency in French and English, both written and spoken.
• Swiss residence: Mandatory Core competencies
• Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility, and Responsibility.
• Compliance with regulations and internal directives
• Curiosity and willingness to learn in a constantly evolving environment. Why Join Our Team? You will join a dynamic and collaborative team where you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in compliance and project management while benefiting from guidance and support to advance your career. You will be involved in strategic and innovative projects at the heart of FCC department. Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile delle operazioni del vault centrale

descriptionByLocale.it: Mission The Central Vault officer is responsible for the management, security and operations of the precious metals vault and physical certificates including security and traceability of all assets entering and leaving the vault. He is working within our institution procedural guidelines to ensure a high quality of service is consistently maintained, with optimum efficiency and all standard operating procedures and Key Performance Indicators being adhered to. He will be working closely with internal management on the strategic global growth of our projects; offering products and services combined into innovative offerings and operational knowledge. Essential Duties Vault main tasks - Places, and fulfills orders from the Private Banking / Clients to maintain required levels of precious metal available in the vault - Ensure physical delivery to Relationship manager and Clients - Handling receipts and deliveries of physical securities and metals - Maintains internal procedures up to date in regards with the security and regulations of the Bank’s vault. - Performs inventory maintenance, verification and accounting entries with reconciliation department - Performs, confirms and maintains banking insurances according to the vault valuation. Trading tasks - Processes, monitors and validates precious metals and private placement - Ensure good receipt of Private Equity subscription and redemption proceeds with external funds managers - Reconciliation and monitoring of holdings, entitlements determination, pending positions - Ensure daily proper record-keeping and development of new activities/business with external providers in regards with vault activities. Supervisory Responsibility - Coordinates and manages Vault activities at all bank branches - Ensure allocation to client accounts and physical securities settlement - Precious metals receiving - Receives and verifies vault deposits, inspects the integrity of bags and seals and notifies management of exceptions. - Ensure follow-up with private company to maintain self-evaluation of private equity - Perform procedures for opening and closing of operations, including vault, alarm and door duties - Ensure that security/control procedures are correctly performed in accordance with established policies Specific competencies - Strong knowledge on financial instruments (equities, bonds, warrants, private placements, restricted securities, funds and other), and their operating flows - Sense of risk associated with the delivery and receipt of securities - Flexibility, adaptation to change - Strong analytical skills with an ability to identify problems and propose solutions. - Sense of priorities and capacity to take decisions - Consistently comply with internal & external regulation Skills and Abilities - Technical knowledge of detailed domain (Compliance and legal competencies appreciated) - CFC bank or equivalent - Fluency in English and French - Experience of at least 5 years in a similar position - Discretion and excellent presentation - MS Office / Banking software / Swift Business daily contacts - Clients - Private Banking - Operations department / Treasury & Trading - Compliance department / Legal department - IT - Banks / Transfer Agents/ Brokers / Custodians / Funds managers Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

title: Graduate Programme Hong Kong, 2026, Wealth Management

titleByLocale.it: Corso di laurea Hong Kong, 2026, Wealth Management
titleByLocale.en: Graduate Programme Hong Kong, 2026, Wealth Management
titleByLocale.de: Graduate Programme Hong Kong, 2026, Wealth Management
titleByLocale.fr: Graduate Programme Hong Kong, 2026, Wealth Management

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Permanent position with a 12-months rotational program within different teams to discover different activities, as well as build expertise and professional skills.
• Rotation 1 – [Business Management Team for 9 months]
• Rotation 2 – [Investment Services Team for 3 months]
• During the program, under supervision of the Head of CE Office as mentor, the Graduate is expected to:
• Get familiar with the organization structure, the roles and responsibilities of different functional teams and the usage of the Bank’s core systems
• Rotate between business management, front office sales team and Investment Services team to learn the key tasks and responsibilities
• The rotation in the business management team will be focus on:
• Support project management: Learn to collaborate with the team on various projects relates to process improvement, operational efficiency, and Front Office risk management
• Coordinate meeting and presentation, including preparing meeting agenda, coordinating schedules, and taking meeting minutes
• Housekeeping: progress and status tracking in client portfolio review, cross-border travel report, and maintain the Business Introducer list
• Daily routine monitoring task in the Business Management Team
• Coordinate in project UAT / Testing arrangement
• The Graduate will be attached to Assistants of Private Banker to learn the daily tasks carried out in the Front Office, e.g. selling process, order taking from client, handling remittance, account maintenance etc.
• Main responsibilities in the Investment Services Team:
• The Graduate will be attached to various investment/product specialist to learn about the products offering from the bank, e.g. Equity, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, Structured Products and Alternative Investments, and the key products features and characteristics of these products
• The Graduate will learn from the Advisory team on engaging private client for investment products
• At the end of all rotations, the Graduate is expected to be fully trained in:
• Front Office practices and requirements
• Products and services offered in Private Banking
• Business Management for Private Banking Front Office
• Professional organizational behaviour and conduct in an international Private Bank
• Starting Date: September 2026 Rationale – Why Business Management Team in Private Bank? Joining Business Management team in a Private Bank can be a valuable opportunity to kickstart the Graduate’s career in the Finance industry. For example:
• Practical experience and exposure: Private Banks are at the forefront of the financial industry and the exposures in the Business Management team offers the Graduate get into the inner working of how a private bank operates. The Graduate will gain a comprehensive understanding of the banking operations, risk management, compliance, and client services. This exposure will help the Graduate develop a solid foundation of knowledge and provide a first-hand understanding of the dynamics of the financial sector.
• Skill developments: The internship in a business management team allows the Graduate to develop and enhance essential skills that are highly valued in the finance industry. For example, project management skills, problem solving skills, communication skills, and teamwork etc.
• Networking opportunities: Due to the nature of Business Management team which connects the Front Offices to all the functional team in the middle and back offices, it opens doors to networking opportunities. The Graduate will have the chance to interact with professionals from various departments within the bank, including Bankers, senior executives, investment advisors, COO and Compliance etc. Building relationship with these important individuals can be invaluable, as they can provide guidance, mentorship, and potential future job opportunities. Candidates with, at minimum, a bachelor's degree (or in the final-year study) and, no more than 12 months of full-time post-graduate work experience are welcome to apply.

• Support project management: Learn to collaborate with the team on various projects relates to process improvement, operational efficiency, and Front Office risk management
• Coordinate meeting and presentation, including preparing meeting agenda, coordinating schedules, and taking meeting minutes
• Housekeeping: progress and status tracking in client portfolio review, cross-border travel report, and maintain the Business Introducer list
• Daily routine monitoring task in the Business Management Team
• Coordinate in project UAT / Testing arrangement
• The Graduate will be attached to Assistants of Private Banker to learn the daily tasks carried out in the Front Office, e.g. selling process, order taking from client, handling remittance, account maintenance etc.
• Main responsibilities in the Investment Services Team:
• The Graduate will be attached to various investment/product specialist to learn about the products offering from the bank, e.g. Equity, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, Structured Products and Alternative Investments, and the key products features and characteristics of these products
• The Graduate will learn from the Advisory team on engaging private client for investment products
• At the end of all rotations, the Graduate is expected to be fully trained in:
• Front Office practices and requirements
• Products and services offered in Private Banking
• Business Management for Private Banking Front Office
• Professional organizational behaviour and conduct in an international Private Bank
• Starting Date: September 2026 Rationale – Why Business Management Team in Private Bank? Joining Business Management team in a Private Bank can be a valuable opportunity to kickstart the Graduate’s career in the Finance industry. For example:
• Practical experience and exposure: Private Banks are at the forefront of the financial industry and the exposures in the Business Management team offers the Graduate get into the inner working of how a private bank operates. The Graduate will gain a comprehensive understanding of the banking operations, risk management, compliance, and client services. This exposure will help the Graduate develop a solid foundation of knowledge and provide a first-hand understanding of the dynamics of the financial sector.
• Skill developments: The internship in a business management team allows the Graduate to develop and enhance essential skills that are highly valued in the finance industry. For example, project management skills, problem solving skills, communication skills, and teamwork etc.
• Networking opportunities: Due to the nature of Business Management team which connects the Front Offices to all the functional team in the middle and back offices, it opens doors to networking opportunities. The Graduate will have the chance to interact with professionals from various departments within the bank, including Bankers, senior executives, investment advisors, COO and Compliance etc. Building relationship with these important individuals can be invaluable, as they can provide guidance, mentorship, and potential future job opportunities. Candidates with, at minimum, a bachelor's degree (or in the final-year study) and, no more than 12 months of full-time post-graduate work experience are welcome to apply.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission
• The mission consists in performing the role of IT business analyst for Risk applications, in particular for subjects related to Balance Sheet Management, Value At Risk (VaR), Reconciliation and IRRBB / CSRBB regulations.
• The candidate needs to have an extensive IT risk management banking background as well as a strong BA experience.
• Main responsibilities
• Reporting to the Team Lead of IT Risk, Credit & ESG, the consultant will work on risk application projects.
• IT BA Responsibilities
• Analyse regulation, business scenarios/cases and contribute to business / regulatory requirements definition.
• Eg : Impact of products evolution (Acumulator / Decumulator, Deposits, Credit and Mortgages) on the Balance Sheet Management (BSM) IT treatment
• Define Functional Design Specification.
• Manage vendor (FIS) application relationship (software package).
• Execute database scripts and queries (SQL) to validate data integrity and ensure alignment with regulatory requirements.
• Install and test new versions of BSM and VaR Hedge Funds Applications and exploit the applications in production (batch error management).
• Liaise with the business to provide guidance from an IT point of view.
• Provide guidance for business analysts, developers, and testers assigned to the projects and ensure good project management practices are employed throughout the project lifecycle.
• Identify key risks and issues and define mitigation scenarios.
• Your Profile
• 5 to 10 years of experience
• Education : Master Degree in IT
• Experience required
• IT Business Analyst with strong technical and functional skills on Risk Management – FIS Balance Sheet Manager – Var HF & Reconciliation (based on MATLAB)
• Proficient in SQL and database scripting for risk data analytics.
• Good understanding of the bank’s business processes
• Good operational experience in the implementation of various IT Risk Management projects in banking or financial sectors related to risk management, VaR reconciliation, IRRBB (Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book) / CSRBB (Credit Spread Risk in the Banking Book) regulations.
• Good practrice of IT BA activities and knowledge of IT project management
• Languages:
• French mandatory and English (C1)
• Others
• Swiss residency: Optional

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission As part of the Tax Services team, the Tax Specialist is a key element to ensure the quality and accuracy of the reporting done by the Bank, as a regulatory obligation, in an environment which is subject to constant changes and evolutions. Within the Daily Regulatory Reporting team, the employee’s mission also includes constant monitoring and reconciliation of the data to be reported. The tax and regulatory topics include MIFID II/ EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG / Duty to disclose.
• Main responsibilities
• Daily monitoring and control of regulatory reporting (MIFID II / EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG) sent to the reporting platform(s) (i.e. locals regulators)
• Monthly reconciliations, quality control and statistics of the data reported
• Manage inquiries and investigate questions and issues about the taxes or regulatory reporting from other departments of the Bank or from external counterparties
• Understand regulatory risk sensitivity and has an end-to-end view of the Bank’s flow/process
• Correction of consistency issues, update reporting tool’s database
• Liaising and coordinating with the department responsible for the underlying data for the necessary corrections, explanations, data input and resubmission of the corrected report(s)
• Communication with the reporting engine providers (ARM, APA, TR)
• Performing regular and ad-hoc reporting related to statistics for internal and external parties
• Contribute to all testing linked to regulatory and reporting updates
• Active participation in EMIR/MIFID/DTD projects (Audit inquiries, Provider specifications changes & Regulator inquiries) including data mining and in-depth investigation
• Open mind and team orientation: Be open to other’s ideas. Express and accept constructive criticism.
• Innovation and development: Propose and seek improvement of the current tools and processes. Be positive towards change and seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment. Conitunuously work on knowledge improvement.
• Corporate culture: Be ‘solution oriented’ and have a strong sense of customer services. Be proactive and driven. Developp and maintain a relationship network within the various Bank departments. Comply consistently with internal and external regulations.
• Your Profile
• Good knowledge of the financial products and associated transactions
• 3-5 years of experience in banking or financial services
• Project management experience
• Strong Excel, Access skills
• Strong analytical skills, able to make complex data reconciliation
• Ability to efficiently manage priorities
• Be able to work independently but also as a team
• Seek opportunities to improve the existing set-up
• Go beyond specific assignments, walk the extra mile
• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations
• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures
• Fluent in French and English
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Within the Daily Regulatory Reporting team, the employee’s mission also includes constant monitoring and reconciliation of the data to be reported. The tax and regulatory topics include MIFID II/ EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG / Duty to disclose.

• Main responsibilities
• Daily monitoring and control of regulatory reporting (MIFID II / EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG) sent to the reporting platform(s) (i.e. locals regulators)

• Monthly reconciliations, quality control and statistics of the data reported

• Manage inquiries and investigate questions and issues about the taxes or regulatory reporting from other departments of the Bank or from external counterparties

• Understand regulatory risk sensitivity and has an end-to-end view of the Bank’s flow/process

• Correction of consistency issues, update reporting tool’s database

• Liaising and coordinating with the department responsible for the underlying data for the necessary corrections, explanations, data input and resubmission of the corrected report(s)

• Communication with the reporting engine providers (ARM, APA, TR)

• Performing regular and ad-hoc reporting related to statistics for internal and external parties

• Contribute to all testing linked to regulatory and reporting updates

• Active participation in EMIR/MIFID/DTD projects (Audit inquiries, Provider specifications changes & Regulator inquiries) including data mining and in-depth investigation

• Open mind and team orientation:
Be open to other’s ideas.
Express and accept constructive criticism.

• Innovation and development:
Propose and seek improvement of the current tools and processes.
Be positive towards change and seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment.
Conitunuously work on knowledge improvement.

• Corporate culture:
Be ‘solution oriented’ and have a strong sense of customer services.
Be proactive and driven.
Developp and maintain a relationship network within the various Bank departments.
Comply consistently with internal and external regulations.

• Your Profile
• Good knowledge of the financial products and associated transactions

• 3-5 years of experience in banking or financial services

• Project management experience

• Strong Excel, Access skills

• Strong analytical skills, able to make complex data reconciliation

• Ability to efficiently manage priorities

• Be able to work independently but also as a team

• Seek opportunities to improve the existing set-up

• Go beyond specific assignments, walk the extra mile

• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations

• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures

• Fluent in French and English

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission
• The Middle Officer in Asset Management acts as the central point of contact for operational queries, ensuring timely client responses and smooth transaction processing. Key responsibilities include trade matching, settlement follow-up, daily reconciliations, collateral management, and issue resolution. The role also involves producing activity reports, collaborating with counterparties, and implementing new processes to enhance operational efficiency.
• Main responsibilities
• Act as the central point of contact for operational queries, and always available to respond to our client queries in a timely manner
• Securities & FX trade matching, instruction to relevant third parties and settlement follow-up
• OTC & ETD trade matching, and clearing monitoring
• Produce the daily activity reports to third parties
• Perform daily reconciliations of portfolio positions, cash balances and transactions.
• Breaks analysis, investigation until resolution
• Participation in the implementation of new processes and controls
• Oversee the daily management of collateral for derivatives
• Perform daily reconciliations of collateral balances with counterparties, resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.
• Collaborate with counterparties, clearing brokers, and custodians to ensure smooth collateral movements and settlements.
• Your Profile
• +5 years of experience in Asset Management / Operations or FX activities
• University degree(s) in accounting, finance and/or business management
• Strong knowledge of fund structures, share class operations, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., EMIR, UCITS, AIFMD).
• Deep understanding of currency markets, hedging instruments (e.g., forwards, swaps), and collateral management practices.
• Specific competencies
• Strong Analytical skills and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams.
• High attention to detail and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
• Awareness of risks and focus on risks mitigation techniques
• Rigour and organization skills
• Result oriented, driven to succeed
• Ability to work in a dynamic, high demand environment
• Fluent in French and English, other language(s) a plus
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within tight deadlines.
• Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation.
• Swiss residency Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission Veiller à la maintenance et à la sécurité des locaux tout en assurant le bien-être de leurs occupants. Capacité à trouver des solutions efficaces et pragmatiques répondant aux besoins techniques des utilisateurs
• Main responsibilities
• Répondre aux demandes des collaborateurs sur les problématiques liées aux locaux et équipements.
• Effectuer les petites réparations et interventions de maintenance de premier niveau.
• Contrôler l'état général des bâtiments et signaler les anomalies.
• Coordonner et accompagner les prestataires lors des interventions en s'assurant du respect des règles de sécurité de la banque.
• Vérifier visuellement les installations techniques et remonter les différents problèmes.
• Participer à l'organisation des espaces de travail.
• Effectuer des déménagements internes et des mises en place de mobiliers.
• Participer à la gestion des stocks de fournitures et passer les commandes validées par le responsable.
• Vérifier le bon fonctionnement des équipements de sécurité.
• Appliquer les consignes de sécurité de la banque.
• Participer au piquet technique.
• Your Profile
• Expérience attendue de Facilities officer en interne ou dans une société de service.
• Connaissances en bâtiment. o Electricité : vérification des installations et relamping. o Plomberie : Débouchage de canalisations simples et entretien des sanitaires. o Serrurerie/Menuiserie : Ajustement portes des fenêtres et du mobilier, changement des serrures. o Revêtement : remplacement de revêtement sols.
• Polyvalence et autonomie dans l'exécution des tâches.
• Réactivité et capacité à gérer les urgences.
• Sens du service et excellent relationnel.
• Rigueur et respect des consignes.
• Background
• High School/ Maturité / Baccalauréat
• Connaissances en sécurité incendie et accessibilité des bâtiments.
• Excel, GMAO, Ticketing. Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

TEMPORARY MISSION - 6 MONTHS
• Mission Ensure the accurate and timely processing of income payments for all bank accounts while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and internal controls. Provide exceptional service to clients and stakeholders, ensuring smooth operations within the income processing function.
• Main responsibilities Income Processing
• Process income-related transactions, including dividends, interest payments, and other distributions.
• Ensure accuracy and timeliness in accordance with established procedures and regulations. Reconciliation and Verification
• Reconcile and verify income transactions, ensuring correct allocation to client accounts.
• Investigate and resolve discrepancies or exceptions.
• Manage market claims and liaise with external brokers and counterparties. Client Communication
• Address inquiries from Relationship Managers, internal stakeholders, and external parties (e.g., custodians, issuers, agents).
• Provide updates and maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service. Documentation and Recordkeeping
• Maintain accurate records of income transactions and related documentation.
• Ensure proper documentation for audit and regulatory purposes. Regulatory Compliance
• Stay informed on relevant regulations, industry practices, and internal policies
• Your Profile
• Languages: French, English Personal skills:
• Think in "Problem-Action-Results" terms
• Be proactive and driven
• Show strong client service ethic
• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures
• Highly organized, manage tight deadlines within a high-risk environment, ability to work under pressure
• Strong analytical skills with an ability to identify problems and propose solutions.
• Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way
• Be a continuous learner
• Adaptability, self-motivation and teamwork
• Good understanding of the risks inherent to the corporate actions environment and demonstrate good discipline around control and escalation.
• Build lasting client relationships
• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

titleByLocale.fr: Graduate Programme – Group Risk Management team

descriptionByLocale.it:
The Group’s risk management activities are overseen by Group Risk Management, led by the Group Head of Risk Management (Chief Risk Officer / CRO). In Switzerland, Group Risk Management teams are responsible for overseeing the Bank’s activities, while ensuring local alignment with Group standards at an international level. They coordinate methodologies, implement transversal risk management initiatives and lead key local projects in close collaboration with Group-level risk representatives. The Swiss Risk Management function is structured into specialized teams covering Treasury & Trading, Asset Management, Wealth Management and Operational Risk. In addition a dedicated Project team provides cross-functional support for key initiatives led by the CRO or team heads. Acting as a second line of defense, the Risk teams serve as trusted advisors to the Business, participate to local committees, perform independent controls and support the definition and implementation of mitigation plans in coordination with risk owners (1st line of defense). Mission As of 1 September 2026, Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is offering a permanent position within its Group Risk Management teams (2nd line of defense) in Geneva, starting with a 12‑month training program that includes regular interactions with other Bank functions and Legal Entity representatives across the Group. descriptionByLocale.it:
Investments Data Analyst - Portfolio Guardian 12 months temporary mission About COO Investment Management:
• The COO Investment Management department at Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is the operational backbone of the bank’s investment platform. It orchestrates the strategy, governance, processes, data, and technology that enable UBP’s investment teams to deliver high-quality, compliant, and scalable outcomes for clients across discretionary, advisory, and fund management activities.
• Mission You will Work inside the Investments COO Investment Management (COO IM) Office and engage with our Buy-Side stakeholders, Discretionary Portfolio Managers (DPM), Product Specialists and Buy Side Analysts. As a Portfolio Guardian, your mission is to safeguard the integrity, consistency, and client alignment of our managed portfolios across their entire lifecycle. You will act as the first line of defense for portfolio quality — ensuring that investment intent is faithfully implemented, risks are understood and controlled, and mandates remain compliant with guidelines and regulations. You will also architect, build, and deploy high-impact software solutions in fast-moving, high-stakes environments inside the Investment Project and Tools team. You operate as a force multiplier across the stack — rapidly assessing the terrain, selecting the right tools, and executing with precision to deliver secure, resilient, and mission-critical capabilities.
• Main responsibilities Portfolio Guardian
• Take ownership of risk/breach dashboards and other Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) solutions, including end-to-end oversight of underlying data-sourcing processes.
• Create solutions that support Portfolio Managers in managing their discretionary mandates.
• Manage existing discretionary models and datasets, ensuring analytics tools correctly source, reconcile, and integrate data from external providers and cross-functional systems.
• Maintain First Line of Defence (LOD1) risk controls and produce high-quality presentations and reports for DPM leadership and internal teams.
• Administer and maintain databases; collaborate closely with Quant, Performance, and Reporting teams to align models, metrics, and delivery timelines.
• Oversee and improve instrument data quality used in product factsheets (equities and bonds), including validation, enrichment, and issue remediation. Front Office Tactical Commando
• Develop tactical solutions for the Investment Services floor in commando mode, in alignment with Union Bancaire Privée (UBP)’s technological framework.
• Optimize processes and tactical tools within Investment Services.
• Contribute to the analytical and technical analysis of business requirements
• Participate in transversal projects as part of the COO IM team.
• Lead the design and delivery of Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and orchestrate their transition to production, coordinating handover and implementation with UBP IT.
• Your Profile
• You hold a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Financial Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or an equivalent quantitative/scientific discipline.
• You bring substantial experience working with large-scale, distributed datasets, as well as demonstrated expertise in automation and process optimization.
• You have a strong interest and relevant experience in the financial industry, with a solid understanding of investment instruments and/or applications of Artificial Intelligence within finance.
• You are proficient in Python development and writing complex SQL queries, with experience using APIs. You have excellent knowledge of the Pandas and NumPy packages and proven experience in project development or automation, data management, and data analysis.
• You have the confidence and credibility to challenge assumptions, question data integrity, and provide constructive, influential input.
• You are experienced in modeling and in presenting data with data visualization tools (ideally Power BI).
• You possess outstanding analytical, data-manipulation, and statistical-modeling skills, bringing strong quantitative rigor.
• You operate autonomously with a high level of accountability, demonstrating exceptional attention to detail.
• You are accustomed to managing multiple priorities in a high-paced environment.
• You are flexible, solutions-oriented, and intellectually curious, with a proven ability to solve complex problems and adapt to evolving priorities.
• Experience with OMS Aladdin and/or PMS AAA is a plus.
• French / English proficiency
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a leading Private Bank specializing in Wealth Management (WM), offering tailored financial solutions to a diverse international clientele. Data analytics plays a key role in strengthening operational oversight, improving client understanding, and enhancing compliance and risk management processes. As a WM Data Scientist within the COO Wealth Management office, you will work at the intersection of data science, WM operational processes, and compliance analytics. The role focuses on analyzing internal data to identify patterns in client activity, operational workflows, and risk indicators, helping the organization better detect anomalies, improve client monitoring frameworks, and strengthen decision-making. This position goes beyond traditional reporting. You will apply statistical methods, behavioral analytics, and quantitative modelling to improve rule-based monitoring frameworks, support client lifecycle analytics, and optimize operational risk controls. The role also includes contributing to the definition of analytical frameworks and data specifications that will support future AI initiatives within the Wealth Management COO organization. Mission Development of intelligent analytical solutions to complex operational and risk-related problems by extracting, transforming, modelling, and analysing data across multiple banking systems. The role focuses particularly on analytical challenges at the intersection of WM operations, compliance monitoring, and business risk controls, including the optimisation of monitoring alerts and detection frameworks. You will be mentored by the Head of WM Reporting & Dashboards located in our Zurich office, with occasional travel to Geneva. Main responsibilities
• Extract, transform, and structure data from multiple internal banking systems and operational processes
• Perform advanced statistical analysis and data exploration to identify behavioural patterns in client activity and operational processes
• Analyse and refine rule-based monitoring scenarios and threshold parameters used in transaction monitoring frameworks
• Develop quantitative models and analytical approaches to improve client segmentation, lifecycle analysis, and risk indicators
• Contribute to the optimisation of monitoring alerts and detection frameworks related to client activity and transaction behaviour
• Translate analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations for operational, compliance, and management stakeholders
• Contribute to defining analytical specifications and data frameworks supporting future advanced analytics and AI initiatives Qualifications
• Academic degree (BA/MA) in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in a similar role
• Banking experience strongly preferred, or experience in a similar data science environment
• International work experience desired for this role
• Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
• Experience working with large datasets and applying statistical or quantitative methods to operational, compliance, or risk-related problems
• Experience analysing rule-based monitoring frameworks, risk indicators, or behavioural patterns in financial data is highly valued
• Strong technical skills in SQL and Python
• Experience with data visualisation or business intelligence tools (e.g. Power BI) is beneficial but not the primary focus of the role
• Exposure to transaction monitoring, KYT/KYC processes, or compliance analytics is a must
• Strong analytical and curious mind with excellent research, communication, and presentation skills
• Self-discipline, quality conscious and goal-oriented approach and readiness for an agile working environment Candidates must have the legal right to work in Switzerland at the time of hire. This position is 100% on-site in Zurich, Switzerland. Start: asap

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Job Summary
• The Securities Master File Specialist is a critical role within the bank, responsible for managing and maintaining the integrity of financial instrument data across Wealth Management and Asset Management businesses. This role ensures the accurate and timely setup, maintenance, and monitoring of securities and benchmarks, supporting front office teams, risk management, operations, and client reporting.
• In addition to the core responsibilities, the Securities Master File Specialist will play a pivotal role in the project to replace the current tool managing the securities master file . This includes contributing significantly to the success of the project by actively participating in testing, data migration validation, and supporting the adoption of the new platform.
• The ideal candidate will have a strong attention to detail, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. The role also involves active participation in project management initiatives to enhance processes, systems, and data quality.
• Key Responsibilities
• Securities and Prices Management
• Open and update financial instruments in the database, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
• Process requests for new instrument setups from various business units, including Private Banking, Asset Management, Treasury, and Trading.
• Conduct thorough analysis and research of additional information (e.g., prospectuses, offering documents, term sheets, and data providers).
• Enter and maintain additional information in the Instruments Database.
• Manage and monitor prices and Net Asset Values (NAV) per share.
• Perform regular controls to ensure data quality and integrity.
• Data Quality Assurance
• Execute daily, weekly, and monthly processes and controls to maintain a high level of data quality service.
• Ensure data accuracy to support front office teams, risk management, and operations.
• Participate in the implementation of new procedures, projects, and controls.
• Document all processes with operational procedures (including process flows, risks, controls, and key performance indicators).
• Role in the Securities Master File tool replacement project
• Testing and Validation:
• Actively participate in defining and executing test cases for the new platform.
• Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and collaborate with project teams to resolve issues.
• Ensure the new tool meets functional and operational requirements.
• Data Migration and Quality Control:
• Validate the accuracy and completeness of data migrated to the new platform.
• Perform detailed checks to identify and address discrepancies in the migrated data.
• Change Management and User Support:
• Contribute to the development of user guides, training materials, and process documentation for the new tool.
• Provide training and support to end-users to ensure a smooth transition to the new platform.
• Act as a key point of contact for feedback and troubleshooting during the implementation phase.
• Core competencies
• Behave Ethically
• Communicate Effectively
• Foster Teamwork
• Creativity/Innovation
• Organize
• Plan
• Lead / Manage
• Make Decisions
• Solve Problems Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission Ensuring that new and/or existing clients to the bank, for the Emerging Markets & Eastern Europe region, are compliant with laws, regulations such as AML, CDB, FATCA, CRS and internal guidelines and standards. To provide market expertise and support to the Compliance WM team, handling the day-to-day spectrum of account openings and mutations for Geneva, ensure that business lines adhere to applicable regulatory requirements (Finma, CDB, etc…).
• Main responsibilities
• Analyse all kind of Compliance High Risk and complex cases with the Private Banking activity
• Review account openings and perform checks in databases and searches to identify and mitigate any AML, legal or reputational risk
• Prepare memos and submit cases to relevant Committee/s of the Bank
• Monitor law and regulatory changes which may lead to change in customer servicing and internal policies, both within the core Market as well as in Switzerland
• Assure that local and Swiss laws, regulations, and internal guidelines are respected in the process of the account opening and modifications
• May be involved in different Compliance Projects
• Act as business partner to other team members and departments of the Bank when required
• Any other task required by Management relating to the Mission of the employee
• Work collaboratively with other Compliance teams within and outside Switzerland
• Provide guidance, Market expertise, support and relevant information to the Front Office
• Your Profile
• Previous experience of at least 5 years in a similar function with market expertise in the Emerging Markets and Eastern Europe region
• University degree or completed by the Certificate of Compliance Management or equivalent
• Proficiency level of French and English.
• Proficiency level in Russian
• Capacity to manage many tasks at the same time
• Interpersonal skills, very good in negotiation
• Strong team spirit
• Synthetic and pragmatic, with a good analytical spirit
• Delivery oriented
• Discreet Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission & Main duties of SIU team
• Main unit of WM Compliance responsible for internal investigative efforts and handling of cases with enhanced FCC risk.
• Team’s main duty is to handle internal investigations with the responsibility to conclude them in the timely manner and observance of Bank’s regulatory and reporting duties.
• Key responsibilities Senior Compliance Officer in SIU :
• Handling of internal investigations, internal escalations, submission of files to AML Committee for the decision regarding SAR filing and answers to Authority Requests.
• Additional responsibilities include daily screening of client names, handling Request for Information (RFI) for correspondent banks and media watch.
• Treatment of internal and external audit requests as well as analysis of files with high management attention.
• Main Committees:
• AMLC
• ARC
• Sanctions Committee
• Core competencies:
• Knowledge of Swiss Banking regulations, provisions of Swiss AML law, Swiss Criminal Code and MROS practice
• Experience in Financial Crime Compliance and AML
• Strong adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility, and Responsibility.
• Compliance with regulations and internal directives.
• Specific Competencies and other Skills/Abilities:
• Curiosity, adaptability, analytical and holistic approach, ability to work in a team and drawing conclusions upon collected facts. Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Main Responsibilities The UK Regulatory Compliance Team is primarily responsible for providing timely, risk-based advice, challenge, and enablement to the business on regulatory matters. The Investor Protection Compliance team sits within UK Regulatory Compliance and assists in managing compliance risk across UBP UK, contributing to regulatory change implementation, and helping to maintain effective policies, training, and governance in line with UK requirements and UBP standards relating to investor and client protection. Investor Protection Compliance ensure investors and clients are treated fairly and transparently, topics include but are not limited to; disclosures, suitability & appropriateness, conflicts of interest, complaints handling, marketing and client communications, vulnerable customers, responsible lending, product governance and best execution.
• The role holder is responsible for:
• supporting the team in fulfilling the responsibilities set out above.
• supporting the team and assisting in the management of compliance risk across UBP UK’s business. In providing advisory support, the role holder will liaise with colleagues in the UK Regulatory Compliance team, Financial Crime and overseas offices as appropriate to ensure local regulations and wider department processes are considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Environment: The Structured Products Team of the Treasury and Trading Department is in charge of the issuance process, the hedging and the monitoring of the structured products issued by the bank. The team is also in charge of the trading of OTC Equity Derivatives such as Equity Options and Equity Accumulators/Decumulators. This junior position provides a great opportunity to join a dynamic team on the trading floor and to strengthen your skills in OTC Equity Derivatives and Structured Products trading. As a Junior Derivatives & Structured Products Specialist, you will support the team in all its business activities, and you will reinforce your knowledge and experience about capital markets and OTC Equity Derivatives and Structured Products trading. Mission:
• Trading of OTC Equity Derivatives such as OTC Equity Options and Equity Accumulators/Decumulators.
• Structuration, hedging and trading of the structured products issued by the bank (cross-asset with a strong focus on equity linked products).
• Monitoring of the structured products lifecycle management (underlying performance, corporate event, coupon, early redemption and maturity redemption).
• Improvement of the structured products issuance and the OTC derivatives trading processes automation. Main duties:
• Trading of OTC Equity Derivatives such as OTC Equity Options and Equity Accumulators/Decumulators.
• Trading of structured products and their hedges with internal and external counterparties on the primary and secondary markets.
• Development of IT tools to increase trading efficiency and to avoid operational risks.
• Assistance to the team for regulatory and legal aspects (Termsheets, Key Information Documents, Target Markets, …). Profile: Previous experience of 1 to 3 years in trading OTC Equity Derivatives and Structured Products Education: Master degree with a specialization in Finance is a strong plus Excellent knowledge of Excel and Bloomberg Programming skills in VBA is a plus High Motivation, high attention to detail Excellent entrepreneurial and organizational skills Quantitative, analytical and flexible Very strong team spirit and ability to partner with other teams Fluent in French and English Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
